note: Attacker-controlled record size parsed from the VBA dir stream; for the crafted MODULE record this size is 2 while the whole inflated buffer is 8 bytes.
Top-level record check only verifies the declared record fits in the buffer (6 + 2 == 8, passes); it does not bound the inner fixed-size record-field reads of the MODULE record.
data_offset is advanced by the unchecked size (2) to exactly data_len (8); the MODULE-record parser then reads the next record id without verifying data_offset + 2 <= data_len.
Unchecked 16-bit dereference of data[8..9] past the 8-byte inflated dir buffer -> heap-buffer-overflow read (ASAN).
